pages.text: The root of an instant spell. Provides origin, action and optional casting-condition slots. Right-click an Beginner Wand to cast.

pages.title: Using this core
pages.text: Insert this core directly into the writing table. The canvas root cannot be removed by right-clicking; use Take core to extract the whole assembly.$(br2)With no child nodes, it remains this typed spell core. A nonempty incomplete assembly becomes an Unformed Spell Core. Parameters are retained even when empty.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 500 to start, plus the spell. A purely decorative spell starts at 0.01.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Default Focus Cost
pages.text: Each cast costs 5 + 10*C + 0.625*C^2 focus. C is total structural complexity. The fixed 5 is never discounted. Each channeling pulse is a separate cast.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)trigger type$(br)Origin / Insert one node$(br2)$(li)action$(br)Action / Insert one node
